subject.title: [Bug]: macOS app 'Launch at login' stops sticking / appears to turn itself off after app updates

question: Should the macOS app persist OpenClaw-owned Launch at login intent and re-register the app LaunchAgent after updates when launchd state drifts?
rationale: Current code treats live launchd state as authoritative, while the report expects the user's in-app enabled intent to survive app replacement and update-time registration drift; that choice affects user control and upgrade semantics.

options.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
options.body: Store an OpenClaw-owned enabled intent and re-register only the app-owned LaunchAgent after startup/update drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.

options.title: Keep launchd authoritative
options.body: Treat macOS launchd/System Settings state as the only source of truth and update UI or docs so the app does not restore a disabled login item.

options.title: Wait for live update proof
options.body: Keep the issue parked until a packaged Sparkle update repro shows exactly which state flips before choosing repair behavior.

recommendation.title: Persist intent and reconcile drift
recommendation.body: Store an OpenClaw-owned enabled intent and re-register only the app-owned LaunchAgent after startup/update drift, with guards for deliberate external disablement.
